create.name: Eileen Strong
create.bio:
Eileen Strong is a Quantum-Touch instructor and practitioner who works from a therapy room in Belper, Derbyshire, and offers some of her work online to clients abroad. Over more than fifteen years she has trained in a range of holistic and energy-based methods, adding coaching skills more recently. She first learnt Quantum-Touch over a decade ago and still enjoys experimenting with it, and she is also attuned to traditional Usui Reiki.

Her one-to-one sessions use Quantum-Touch's light touch, breath and body awareness, or Reiki, to support the natural flow of life-force energy. As an instructor she runs the two-day Quantum-Touch Becoming Energised (Level 1) workshop in person, in Belper and in Cheltenham, open to beginners as well as to those who already practise energy work. Meditation has been part of her life for many years and she has taught it since 2014, including through her own online course for newcomers, Learn to Love to Meditate. A keen sketcher, she also offers Spirit-Led Art Readings: a portrait and reading produced through automatic drawing, which she sees as guidance from spirit for someone at a crossroads in life.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Quantum-Touch sessions at her therapy room in Belper, given clothed while seated, standing or lying down. Eileen uses a very light touch with breath and body awareness to raise the energy of the person she works with, and can also work at a distance.

courses.title: Reiki sessions
courses.description: Usui Reiki sessions in Belper, in which Eileen channels life-force energy through the chakras and meridians to encourage balance, ease and inner peace.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Becoming Energised (Level 1), Cheltenham
courses.description: Two full days of in-person training in Charlton Kings, Cheltenham, in the core Quantum-Touch breathing and awareness techniques, suitable for complete beginners. A half-price refresher ticket is available to anyone who has done a live Level 1 class before.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Becoming Energised (Level 1), Belper
courses.description: The same two-day Level 1 workshop held in Belper, Derbyshire, teaching the foundations of running life-force energy through the hands for yourself, family and pets. Refresher and under-18 places are offered at half price.

courses.title: Learn to Love to Meditate
courses.description: Eileen's online introduction to meditation, for people who are curious but unsure where to begin. It explains what meditation is and builds a simple foundational practice for every day.

courses.title: Spirit-Led Art Readings
courses.description: A one-off portrait drawn by automatic drawing, with a written reading, intended as guidance from spirit guides at a turning point in life. Each one takes her about ninety minutes, and a free introductory chat is offered first.
